materials.baseAlphaPolicy: RGB from theme; shell canvas and four opaque fills composite together at 1-T, foregrounds stay opaque; other role alpha is not multiplied by imported palette alpha
materials.surfaceDepth: L0 canvas; each painted card or float adds one actual surface; layout wrappers add none
materials.compositing: Final transmission T*(5-min(L,4))/5; source-over fill 1-Q(L)/Q(L-1); portals compensate for spatially uncovered owners
